name: Small-Scale Source Indicator
definition: For every coordinate reflection $\rho$ for which $C\triangle\rho$ is union closed, let $\varepsilon_0(C\triangle\rho)$ be one when some graph source has a nonempty retained positive separator system and zero otherwise. Then $\eta_0(C)$ is the minimum of these values; the minimum of the empty set is $+\infty$.
normalization: Minimize over all union-closed coordinate reflections; constant coordinates may be suppressed.
comments: The value is invariant under coordinate permutations and reflections. On partial cubes this descends to abstract graph isomorphism because irredundant hypercube embeddings are unique up to those operations.
